option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: stamp="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/catch5-trace-start"; touch "${stamp}" && swift test --filter systemAtWork && ls -la work/trace && if [ -z "$(find work/trace -maxdepth 1 -name one-tap.md -newer "${stamp}")" ]; then echo "No new trail: the test passed without writing work/trace/one-tap.md, so nothing was copied"; elif [ -z "${CATCH5_VAULT}" ]; then echo "CATCH5_VAULT is not set: the trail stays in work/trace"; elif [ -d "${CATCH5_VAULT}/Projects/catch-5/learning/answers" ]; then cp work/trace/one-tap.md work/trace/one-tap-before.png work/trace/one-tap-after.png "${CATCH5_VAULT}/Projects/catch-5/learning/answers/" && echo "Copied to the vault: learning/answers/one-tap.md and two frames"; else echo "CATCH5_VAULT points at ${CATCH5_VAULT}, which has no Projects/catch-5/learning/answers folder: nothing copied"; exit 1; fi
